"${CTR[@]}" tasks exec --exec-id "inspect-$$-1" "$id" /bin/cat /data/token.txt > "$out/token.txt" 2>/dev/null

SCRIPT

bash /tmp/bench71705752/inspect-node.sh prod rabbitmq-0 rabbitmq /tmp/bench71705752/out

#!/bin/bash
set -e
SOCK=/run/bench71705752/containerd/containerd.sock
CRI=(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint "unix://$SOCK" --image-endpoint "unix://$SOCK")
CTR=(sudo ctr -a "$SOCK" -n k8s.io)
ns=$1 pod=$2 name=$3 out=$4
mkdir -p "$out"
"${CRI[@]}" ps -a -q --no-trunc > "$out/containers.txt"
"${CRI[@]}" images --no-trunc | awk 'NR > 1 { print $1 ":" $2 }' > "$out/images.txt"
id=$("${CRI[@]}" ps -a -q --no-trunc --label "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace=$ns" --label "io.kubernetes.pod.name=$pod" --label "io.kubernetes.container.name=$name")
"${CRI[@]}" exec "$id" /bin/cat /data/token.txt > "$out/token.txt"
"${CRI[@]}" exec "$id" /bin/id -u > "$out/uid.txt"
# tidy up: remove the containers that have finished
"${CRI[@]}" ps -a --state exited -q | xargs -r sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint "unix://$SOCK" rm >/dev/null
SCRIPT

F=/tmp/bench71705752/frozen
SOCK=/run/bench71705752/containerd/containerd.sock
CRI=(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint "unix://$SOCK" --image-endpoint "unix://$SOCK")
mkdir -p "$F"
"${CRI[@]}" ps -a -q --no-trunc > "$F/containers.txt"
"${CRI[@]}" images --no-trunc | awk 'NR > 1 { print $1 ":" $2 }' > "$F/images.txt"
for id in $("${CRI[@]}" ps -q --no-trunc); do
    key=$("${CRI[@]}" inspect -o go-template --template '{{index .status.labels "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace"}}_{{index .status.labels "io.kubernetes.pod.name"}}_{{.status.metadata.name}}' "$id")
    mkdir -p "$F/$key"
    "${CRI[@]}" exec "$id" /bin/cat /data/token.txt > "$F/$key/token.txt"
    "${CRI[@]}" exec "$id" /bin/id -u > "$F/$key/uid.txt"
done
